title: BioETL Audit Ledger Event (append-only)
description: Append-only ledger event for reports/audit-runs/<run_id>/ledger.jsonl and master-ledger.jsonl. Events are written AFTER the state change they describe; resume reuses run_id and never replays completed side effects. File is append-only; rewriting history is a corruption.

stage_no.description: Numeric stage index (1..N for kernel iterations, 1..24 for master orchestrator)

stage.description: Stage identity: kernel A..I / scope-freeze..post-audit or master 01..24 / POST_AUDIT / event name

rendered_prompt_sha8.description: Deterministic render hash: 64-hex sha256 or 8-hex short (prompt_sha8). 64-hex is canonical; 8-hex accepted for compatibility.

fingerprint.description: Finding fingerprint when event relates to a finding
